battery_level.docs:

*See also: [ATC MiThermometer](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/atc_mithermometer#configuration-variables)*

ble_hub_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The BLE tracker hub to receive advertisements from. Auto-generated when only one tracker is configured; set it explicitly to disambiguate multiple trackers. Replaces the former `esp32_ble_id` key, which still works as a deprecated alias until ESPHome 2027.2.0.

*See also: [ATC MiThermometer](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/atc_mithermometer#configuration-variables)*
